status: ePSF photometry at residual coordinates in original SPHEREx D1 images; not object confirmation

method.image_model: IRSA ePSF calibration (21x21 spatial zones; 33x33 oversampled by 5); nearest zone selected at each epoch's detector pixel
method.photometry: weighted least-squares ePSF amplitude plus local tilted-plane background; uses each FITS VARIANCE and excludes bad quality bits
method.wavelength: embedded WCS-WAVE bilinearly interpolated at each original-image pixel; compare epoch amplitudes only within half the larger local bandwidth
method.limits: No fitted centroid search, no multi-source deblending, no correlated-noise covariance, and no orbit fit. A point-like difference remains only a transient/source candidate for follow-up.
